title: Offline downloads are here…
message:
Hey everyone…

Aniraku just got a small miracle. One kind user bought a monthly Patreon, and it’s helping keep the lights on. I’m genuinely grateful.

The latest update brings proper offline downloads. After downloading, you might need to refresh or reopen the page once for the file to appear. Working on that little quirk.

Want an anime added, found a bug, or have an idea? Mail us at sho.islam0311@proton.me. It gets quiet sometimes… don’t leave me hanging.

Looking for kind souls to help build Discord & Telegram. I’m not great at community stuff, so any help means a lot.

Want Aniraku to stay alive? Please consider donating. Every bit keeps the episodes playing.

Thank you for still being here.

— the guy who still hasn’t slept enough
